title.narrative: Number (%) of members of target groups who consider that their concerns have been or are being addressed

description.narrative: This indicator can be expressed as a number or as a percentage but not as both. In case of use of percentage, an estimated total number of the targeted population group needs to be known.

comment.narrative: The baseline found that 64 thought their concerns were being addressed in the peace process. These were 26 people out of a small sample of 41 people who had experience of conflict. We aim to measure this indicator again with a larger sample which may result in a different finding. We would like to change this indicator to percentage instead of absolute numbers.

At least 89 of the target population engaged in peacebuilding and mediation are satisfied and consider that their concerns have been or are being addressed in the reconciliation initiatives. The target in absolute numbers that was set for this was 20000 we would like to change this to percentage instead.
